item.title: Ashes 2025-26: WATCH- “Bowl fast when there..”- Steve Smith's dig at Jofra Archer amidst heated argument in Gabba Test
item.description: Australia defeated England in the second Test of the Ashes 2025-26 that was played at the Gabba in Brisbane on December 7, 2025. The hosts took a 2-0 lead in the five-match series with an impressive eight-wicket victory on Sunday. item.title: “Matter of respect for Karnataka”- Deputy CM DK Shivakumar says IPL 2026 games will be played at Chinnaswamy Stadium
item.description: DK Shivakumar, Karnataka's Deputy Chief Minister, stated that Indian Premier League (IPL) matches will continue to be played at Bengaluru's Chinnaswamy Stadium. item.description: A dejected Ben Stokes went on a scathing rant against his England teammates after the team suffered an eight-wicket defeat in the second Ashes Test at Gabba to go 2-0 down in the five-match series versus Australia. item.title: “I want to play a whole series,” Shakib Al Hasan reverses retirement from Tests and T20Is
item.description: Former Bangladesh skipper Shakib Al Hasan has reversed his retirement from Tests and T20Is, expressing his desire to represent the national team across all three formats. Shakib, who has been away from international cricket for over a year, called time on his Test and T20I careers last year. "I am officially not retired from all formats. item.title: “You have to treat them differently,” Sanjay Bangar’s message to Indian team management regarding Virat Kohli, Rohit Sharma
item.description: Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma stole the show in India’s 2-1 ODI series victory over South Africa at home. Both batting stalwarts only play the ODI format now, having retired from T20Is and Tests. Kohli earned the Player-of-the-Series accolade for his 302 runs in the three-match series, including two hundreds (135 and 102) and a half-century (65*).
